turns.reply:
`python3 roster.py inactive` now lists every learner whose last login was 14 or more days ago, with their email, last login date and days since:

```
L-002  Ben Whitlock         ben.w@example.org        2026-09-02  32 days
L-004  Dara Novak           dara@example.org         2026-08-11  54 days
```

I ran it against the current `learners.json` (today being 2026-10-04) and those two are the ones it flags; the other two logged in within the last week.

- **Threshold:** exactly 14 days counts as inactive. It is set by `INACTIVE_AFTER_DAYS` at the top of `roster.py`.
- **Output:** sorted by name like the other commands, but showing last login and days inactive in place of the course list.

I also added the command to the usage text and the README.
